text:
alex_cs: FYI — Acme sent over a bespoke security questionnaire and flagged they need an audit log export and answers around KMS/HSM by EOD Friday. They're hitting an API error when trying to download the export. Raising an escalation so security/SRE can help. Ticket: TCK-4312.

jordan_security: can you paste the exact error payload and the curl you're running? need to know if it's a permission, 401, or algo mismatch.

alex_cs: pasted from customer: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \ 
  \"https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit_logs/export?start=2026-03-01&end=2026-03-15\" -v
# response:
{\"error\":\"permission_denied\",\"code\":403,\"message\":\"kms key not authorized for export\"}
```

maya_sre: 403 + that message usually means the export job attempted to use the customer/KMS key and the exporter principal doesn't have a grant. Are they on Dedicated/Private or hosted?

alex_cs: hosted. Customer says they used the Console -> Security -> Audit exports. They hit the error from the UI and the API.

olivia_prod: we rolled a minor IAM hardening on 2026-03-10 which tightened KMS grants for export roles. Most hosted exports use our service principal with a temporary grant. looks like the grant creation failed for this tenant.

maya_sre: repro steps I recommend: 1) try the export from our side using the customer's org id, 2) check the KMS key grants: 
- AWS: `aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood-audit-<org>` 
- GCP: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy <key> --location=...`
If grant missing, create temp grant and re-run export.

jordan_security: also need to assemble answers for the questionnaire: KMS key rotation cadence, whether HSM used, and audit log retention policy. I can draft canned text once we confirm the key/hardening cause.

alex_cs: customer also asked about tamper detection and deletion windows for logs — they want explicit wording for the SIG/CAIQ bespoke item. deadline is tight and they asked for an extension; asked me to escalate.

tim_oncall: I can create a temporary grant for the export. Command for AWS (run under infra-admin):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-audit-<org> \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-exporter \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
```
For GCP we'd add the serviceAccount as a member in the key's IAM binding.

maya_sre: did that for the org now — I created the grant and retried the export job. export-batch TCK-4312-EX1 succeeded, attached zip to ticket. I also noted a short spike of 5xx errors around 2026-03-09 23:12 UTC which may have caused grant creation race — filing inc-2026-034.

jordan_security: Draft answers for the questionnaire (short bullets you can paste): 
- KMS: We use cloud provider KMS (AWS KMS / Google Cloud KMS) for key management in the hosted product. Keys are rotated automatically at least annually; rotation schedule and proof of rotation are available on request.
- HSM: For Private deployments we offer CloudHSM-backed keys; hosted customers use provider KMS.
- Audit logs: Default retention for hosted audit logs is 365 days; retention can be extended for Dedicated/Private deployments on request.
- Tamper detection: Audit logs are write-once in the storage tier, and exportable with immutable checksums. Any deletion or export action is logged and requires an authorized grant; we maintain an audit trail for key grants and export operations for 365 days.

olivia_prod: small note — avoid saying "HSM backed by Redwood" for hosted; say "Cloud HSM for Private customers". Jordan's bullets ok with that tweak.

alex_cs: I sent the questionnaire answers + the exported logs (link attached in the ticket) and asked Acme for a 48h extension while we investigate the 5xx spike. They confirmed extension til Monday EOD.

audit-bot: export TCK-4312-EX1 completed by maya_sre (file: acme_audit_20260301-0315.zip) :white_check_mark:

maya_sre: added postmortem note to inc-2026-034 and a mitigation: retry grant creation with backoff + alert if grant API returns 4xx/5xx more than twice in 10m.

jordan_security: I'll finalize the security memo for the bespoke responses and attach the KMS rotation policy snippet and link to our key lifecycle doc.

alex_cs: perfect — thanks everyone. I updated the ticket and notified the customer. closing this slack thread. :tada:
